name: ice4-v6.1-original
notes: The exact public v6.1 payload contains calloc(1ull<<35,8), requesting 256 GiB, and thread c[256]. This declared reserve is additional and is not a measured peak.
Planning never launches the artifact. Running needs a new output directory and an explicit --start. No allocation, worker, search, compiler or launcher constant is rewritten.
Memory availability is a transient estimate; this profile does not reserve RAM or create a dedicated cgroup. Many-core performance and tournament acceptance are separate checks.
